declarations.summary:
SECURITY-SENSITIVE. Shows a recovery phrase on demand. Words are set via the `words`
property only (never an attribute), are not rendered into the DOM while hidden, cannot be
copied unless `allow-copy` is set, and are hidden automatically when the page is hidden.
Nothing is stored or sent anywhere. Call `clear()` when done.

declarations.name: OuMnemonicInput

members.name: allowedCounts
members.description: Lengths offered in the selector; empty array hides it. Default [12, 24].

members.name: getMnemonic
members.description: The phrase as a single string, or null unless it is complete and valid.

declarations.summary:
SECURITY-SENSITIVE. Word-by-word recovery phrase entry with BIP39 autocomplete and
checksum validation. Words live only in this component's memory: they are never stored,
never sent, never placed in events. Read them with `getMnemonic()` once valid, then `clear()`.
Browser autocomplete, spellcheck and password managers are disabled on every field.
